'''Blaschowwa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He served the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] and, at some point, traveled to the [[Temple of Pain]], a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] that was located within the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]], where Rystra experimented on him using [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. Circa [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Blaschowwa attacked and was defeated by a group of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] agents who had come to the temple in search of Rystra.

==Biography==
Blaschowwa was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], working as part of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band that served the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]]. At some point, Blaschowwa traveled to the [[Temple of Pain]], a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] located within the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]], where Rystra carried out experiments on the Wookiee in the [[Room of Change]], the temple's [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]]. Under the instruction of the [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirit]] [[Valik Kodank]], Rystra used [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] to alter Blaschowwa and a number of other pirates, turning them into [[Psychopathy|psychopath]]s. Afterward, Blaschowwa was shut inside a room in the laboratory, along with the altered pirates [[Kamtis Bonai]], [[Vobin Sobos]], and [[Desvin Tor'thal]].<ref name="Light and Dark" />

{{RPG|[[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']]}}
Circa [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Child of Light]]'' is set four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], an event that is dated by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' to the sixth month of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. As the ''Atlas'' states that there are twelve months in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], it can therefore be inferred that ''Child of Light'' takes place in the tenth month of 3 ABY. The adventure [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']] is set approximately four months after ''Child of Light'' and can thus be dated to the second month of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']] is set just over three years after ''Soulsaber'' and is therefore placed in around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> a group of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] agents traveled to the Temple of Pain in search of Rystra and entered the Room of Change during their exploration of the facility. The agents opened the door to the room in which Blaschowwa was shut, and Blaschowwa, Bonai, Sobos, and Tor'thal rushed out and attacked them. However, the agents eventually subdued Blaschowwa and the other pirates, and engaged Rystra in combat a short time afterward.<ref name="Light and Dark" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Blaschowwa was heavily altered by Rystra's experiments. As a result, his thoughts became exclusively [[Death/Legends|homicidal]] in their nature, and he was prepared to fight to the death in order to kill others. Blaschowwa was left with very little of his original mind, rendering him unable to use advanced combat tactics, although he retained a greater level of creativity than Bonai, Sobos, and Tor'thal. Rystra also augmented Blaschowwa's claws, allowing the Wookiee to use them to grip walls. Blaschowwa spoke [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]],<ref name="Light and Dark" /> the [[Language/Legends|language]] of the Wookiees,<ref name="Travel Guide">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> and he could also understand [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. In addition, Blaschowwa was trained to use martial arts.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blaschowwa was created by [[Lee Pickler]] and appeared in [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']], a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] supplement published by [[RPGA]] and set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity that formed part of the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]]. In the adventure, it is possible for the players&mdash;who [[Roleplaying game|roleplay]] as the New Republic agents that venture to the Temple of Pain&mdash;to enter the Room of Change and encounter Blaschowwa, where it is possible for them to defeat and kill him.<ref name="Light and Dark" />
